preconditions.description: The number of words parsed from the second line equals the integer n read from the first line.
The number of words n is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.
Every word in the input list is non-empty.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789' for c in w) for w in words)
preconditions.description: Each word consists only of uppercase letters, lowercase letters, and digits.
The total length of all words does not exceed 10^6.

postconditions.description: The output string is the result of merging the words sequentially from left to right, where each merge removes the longest prefix of the second word that matches a suffix of the first.
